test_case.test_command: Operator establishes inventory, disposable storage target and 40C/-5% environment; for each of ten rows reach approved steady load for five minutes, remove AC abruptly, prove off dwell, restore AC, prove BMC/OS readiness, inventory, expected logs and data integrity.
